The '''R4-Salvatron''' was a large [[Salvage droid/Legends|salvage droid]] that worked in the [[Barasin Refuse Yards]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Similar in design to the [[X2H-8 Overseer Droid]], the R4-Salvatron was destroyed by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial forces]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The R4-Salvatron appears as an enemy in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Defeating it is the final stage the bonus mission "Some Disassembly Required," which takes place in the Barasin Refuse Yards in the Imperial version of Balmorra.<ref name="TOR" />
